title: The Lord Reigns

questions.question: The Lord reigns; he is robed in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:1 (ESV): "The Lord reigns; he is robed in majesty;"

questions.question: The Lord is robed; he has put on strength as his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:1 (ESV): "...he has put on strength as his belt."

questions.question: Yes, the world is established; it shall never be what?
Your throne is established from of old; you are from where?
The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:3 (ESV): "...the floods have lifted up their voice;"

questions.question: The floods lift up their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:3 (ESV): "the floods lift up their roaring."

questions.question: Mightier than the thunders of many waters, mightier than the waves of the sea, the Lord on high is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:4 (ESV): "...the Lord on high is mighty!"

questions.question: Holiness befits your house, O Lord, for how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:5 (ESV): "holiness befits your house, O Lord, forevermore."

questions.question: What cannot be moved?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:1 (ESV): "Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved."

questions.question: What is mightier than the waves of the sea?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:4 (ESV): "...the Lord on high is mighty!"

questions.question: From when is God's throne established?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:2 (ESV): "Your throne is established from of old;"

questions.question: This Psalm describes God as king over what?
questions.explanation: The Psalm speaks of the world being established and God's power over the floods/sea.

questions.question: What befits God's house?
questions.explanation: Psalm 93:5 (ESV): "holiness befits your house, O Lord, forevermore."

key_verse_text: The Lord reigns; he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed; he has put on strength as his belt. Yes, the world is established; it shall never be moved.
